Ms. Kajri Gupta, learned counsel holding the 
brief of Mr. Naman Kamboj, learned counsel for the 
applicant.
2. Mr. Vijay Khanduri, learned Brief Holder, for 
the State of Uttarakhand.
3. Mr. Susheel Kumar, learned counsel for the 
respondent no.2.
4. Learned counsel for both the parties, on 
instructions, submits that both the parties have now 
decided to seek divorce by way of mutual consent.
5. Let an affidavit to this effect be filed within a 
week.
6. Put up this matter on 07.10.2026.
7. For an interim measure, further proceedings of 
Criminal Case No.430 of 2025, pending in the court of 
learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, 
Haridwar, is stayed.
8. On the next date, both the parties may join the 
proceeding through VC. 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)

Indu Garg And Ors …………..Applicant
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand ……Respondent
Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Kapil Prasad Gaur, learned counsel for the
applicant.
2. Mr. Himanshu Sain, learned AGA for the State.
3. Mr. Gaurav Singh, learned counsel for the
respondent no. 2.
4. Learned counsel for both the parties submit that both
the applicant no. 3 and respondent no. 2 have settled their
dispute amicably and decided to get divorce by way of
mutual, for which they have already filed a Civil Suit No.
698 of 2026 for seeking divorce which is pending in the
Court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Haridwar wherein
first motion is already completed. They further submit that
both the parties are living separately for the last more than
2 two years and they settled their dispute amicably,
therefore, the Family Court be directed to expedite the
proceeding. 
5. In such view of the matter, the Principal Judge,
Family Court, Haridwar is directed to make all possible
efforts to expedite the proceeding of Civil Suit No. 698 of
2026without compelling the parties to go for judicial
separation for two years, since both the parties are living
separately since last more than two years. 
6. List this case in the week commencing 02.11.2026 so
that in the meantime, both the parties may file their joint
affidavit for closing the instant petition.
 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 07.10.2026
SKS
